Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 27, 1:56 PM ET. It had Pride 5% and Coyotes 95%, projecting Pride 56.8 – Coyotes 74.6 (131.4 total, Coyotes by 17.8).

Final: Pride 47 – Coyotes 99. Right winner: it had Coyotes at 95%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Pride came in with a 25% below average attack and a league-average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 32 and 14 games of evidence. Projected to score 56.8, they scored 47 (−9.8 points, 17% under); projected to allow 74.6, they allowed 99 (+24.4 points, 33% over).

Coyotes came in with a 4% below average attack and a 4% leakier than average defense (4-5, 78.9 scored and 74.1 allowed a game over 9 games), worth about 207 and 205 games of evidence. Projected to score 74.6, they scored 99 (+24.4 points, 33% over); projected to allow 56.8, they allowed 47 (−9.8 points, 17% under).

The bigger miss was Coyotes' scoring (+24.4 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 146 against 131.4 projected (+14.6), about the 84th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14.5).

Margin: Coyotes by 52 against Coyotes by 17.8 projected, about the 99th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±11).

An outlier: the simulations had a result this far off less than about 5% of the time, which usually means an input was wrong or missing, not just bad luck.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: inputs were missing (CKE pts allowed, CKE lineup rating or past seasons); there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.086 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +35.3 points. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 1203 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.978 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Coyotes attack ×1.010, defense ×0.970 (9 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 34.2 points), no bet.
